news.title: ASX finishes flat as BHP, CSL rally, big four banks decline
news.snippet: The Australian sharemarket was lacking a clear overall direction as jumps by heavyweights BHP and CSL following their profit results offset falls in banking, gold and consumer stocks.

news.title: Chariot lines up China-backed Nigerian lithium offtake deal
news.snippet: Chariot Resources surged after inking a deal with Chinese behemoth Xiamen C&D and others for a funded drilling, trial mining and offtake program at its Nigerian lithium projects.

news.title: It’s my job to raise a topic which neither side of politics will mention
news.snippet: These days no one mentions the budget deficit. But they should.

news.title: BHP reports 113 sexual harassment cases in 12 months
news.snippet: The harassment included indecent touching and stalking, while more than two dozen staff were racially abused across BHP’s global operations.

news.title: Sick of AI slop? So are the tech giants
news.snippet: Silicon Valley wants to take out the trash: Swamped by low-quality content first made possible by their own AI tools, Google, Spotify, LinkedIn and others are trying to dig themselves out of their digital sewage pile.

news.title: Changing fortunes: Is biotech giant CSL’s $10b write-down a comeback story?
news.snippet: Make no mistake: the home-grown biotechnology company, which for decades allowed Australia serious boasting rights, is still a long way from redemption.

news.title: Insurers are using your race and religion to set prices. Is it discriminatory?
news.snippet: Legal experts warn insurers using data about the race, religion and grocery habits of suburbs where their customers live could breach discriminations laws.
